_meta.purpose: Initial Drake Ironclad ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = rear-ramp-edge to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes.
_meta.ramp_note: Every zone uses ramp_side='low_y' and ship_forward_y='high'.
_meta.load_doctrine_note: Two separate bays (aft + forward). Each bay is split port/starboard by a central spine the pilot walks down. The pilot enters a bay from the spine and walks OUTBOARD to the hull to load FIRST (outboard = R1/R6/F1/F6), then loads back toward the spine; inboard zones (R3/R4/F3/F4) load LAST. Unloading is the inverse — inboard zones drain FIRST (closest to spine entry), outboard LAST. The aft bay drains entirely before the forward bay is touched, so unload_priority numbers F* zones strictly higher than R* zones.
_meta.adjacency_note: left/right encodes the lateral triplets: R1<->R2<->R3 (port aft), R4<->R5<->R6 (starboard aft), F1<->F2<->F3, F4<->F5<->F6. R3.right and R4.left are null (central spine gap, same for F3/F4). front/back are null everywhere because the aft and forward bays do not share a continuous floor.
_meta.total_scu_note: 6 aft zones x 240 SCU + 6 forward zones x 120 SCU = 1440 + 720 = 2160 SCU.

zones.notes: Aft bay, port outboard (at the hull). Loads FIRST (outboard rule); drains LAST within the aft tier.
Aft bay, port inboard (at the spine). Loads LAST in the port triplet; drains FIRST overall. Right side faces the central spine gap.

Aft bay, starboard outboard (at the hull). Loads FIRST in the starboard triplet; drains LAST in the aft tier. Note labelling: R4..R6 run starboard outboard->inboard reversed vs R1..R3 because R4 sits next to the spine on the starboard side... corrected: R4 is starboard OUTBOARD in this layout (cube_offset_x=8 is the first starboard column after the spine gap, which is the hull-side column for the starboard triplet).
Aft bay, starboard inboard (closest to the spine on the starboard side). Loads LAST in the starboard triplet; drains second overall.
Forward bay, port outboard. Drains second-to-last overall.
Forward bay, port inboard (at the spine). Right side faces the central spine gap.
Forward bay, starboard outboard side after the spine gap. Drains absolute last.
